title: USS Nautilus fitted with a side hatch to grab discs
summary: Richard Dolan tells of USS Nautilus fitted with a side hatch to grab discs, about mid-1960s at USS Nautilus, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: thing that um that we did is we had like this we created this hatch this side hatch to be able to acquire objects that were uh discs uh unknown unknown objects um in the ocean

plain: A writer on UFO history, Richard Dolan, passes on a claim made at the International UFO Congress, a gathering of UFO researchers. According to it, in the mid-1960s the US Navy submarine USS Nautilus was fitted with a special side hatch so it could capture discs and other unknown objects in the ocean. If true, it would mean the Navy was actively trying to collect such objects underwater.
